abstract: Covers OpenID Federation for Trust Anchors, Intermediates, Leaves, Trust Mark Issuers and resolvers, pinned to OpenID Federation 1.0 Final and its 1.1 split into Federation 1.1 and Federation for OpenID Connect 1.1, both Final. The Subordinate Events Endpoint and Extended Subordinate Listing Implementer's Drafts are included at track posture. References are split into entity statements, trust chains, metadata policy, trust marks, endpoints and client registration.
